card.name: Small words in astronomy descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, the, in, into, is, located) inside popular-science astronomy text about galaxies, comets and distances, just before a place or structure is named or described.

modes.label: Galaxy structure and distance
modes.description: Linking word before a description of galaxies, clusters or light-year distances.

modes.label: Solar system origins
modes.description: Linking word before describing where comets come from, such as a cloud or disc-like belt.

card.writes: It suppresses words like cities and towns, steering the model away from naming settlements in space-scale text.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in space-science writing, where a city or town would be the wrong next word.
